id: title:jurajmajerik:extract metric events precompute from the query runner

review.posthog_relevance: Adds eligibility checks and delegation to a dedicated precomputation module for metric events, potentially improving query performance and maintainability, though execution and database changes are not visible.
review.reason: The chunk replaces local eligibility checks and a local implementation with a delegation to a dedicated `MetricEventsPrecompute` class, and removes unused code. This represents a substantive refactoring and centralization of eligibility and build logic. However, the chunk does not include the actual execution, database schema changes, or tests for the underlying precomputation, so,
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the visible refactoring and delegation, but the full benefit and correctness depend on unobserved execution and database changes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a documentation and implementation update. P1.F1.H1 is documentation only. P1.F2.H1 and P1.F2.H2 remove unused imports and a class. P1.F2.H3 and P1.F2.H5 replace a local implementation with a new class and cached property. P1.F2.H6 replaces a large eligibility-check block with a delegation. No tier assignment is made; the chunk is treated as a single group. No score.
